name: bobnet-shield
description: Redacts PII/PHI from tool results before the model reads them: SSNs, card numbers, NPI, Medicare IDs, DEA numbers, record/member IDs, and identifying combinations. Companion to bobiverse.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: redact: replace personal data with [SSN redacted] etc. withhold: drop any tool result that contains personal data. off: do nothing.

medium.title: Also redact combinations
medium.description: Redact DOB-near-a-name, diagnosis codes near diagnosis keywords, phone-near-a-name, and bulk email lists, not only standalone identifiers.
